text: 外交部发言人宣布：中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅与商务部长王文涛将于11月3日在北京共同主持亚太经合组织（APEC）第37届外交和贸易双部长视频会议。
text_en: Foreign Ministry spokesperson announces: Politburo member and Foreign Minister Wang Yi and Commerce Minister Wang Wentao will co-chair the 37th APEC Virtual Meeting of Foreign and Trade Ministers in Beijing on November 3.
